data.name: Section1_Text1
data.value: This policy describes how Kindred Labs Foundation ("we," "us," or "the Foundation") collects, uses, and protects information when you use kindredlabsfoundation.org (the "Site"). The Foundation is in the process of incorporating as a Delaware nonprofit corporation.

data.name: Section1_Text2
data.value: We designed this policy to say what it means. If you have questions, contact us at privacy@kindredlabsfoundation.org.

data.name: Section2_1_Text
data.value: When you create an account, we collect your name, email address, and a hashed password. We also log email verification status, account creation date, and login history for security purposes.

data.name: Section2_2_Text
data.value: If you apply to serve on the Community Data Review Panel, we collect the information you submit in the application form, including professional background, perspectives, areas of expertise, and any conflict-of-interest disclosures. Application data is encrypted at rest.

data.name: Section2_3_Text
data.value: If you contact us through the Site, we collect your name, email address, and the content of your message. We route messages to the appropriate team based on inquiry type.

data.name: Section2_4_Text
data.value: We use Plausible Analytics, a privacy-respecting analytics service, to understand how visitors use the Site. Plausible collects no personally identifiable information, uses no cookies, and does not track users across sites or sessions. Aggregate usage data (page views, referrers, browser type) is used solely to improve the Site.

data.name: Section2_5_Text
data.value: The Site uses a single cookie to remember your language preference (English or Spanish). This cookie contains no personal information and is not used for tracking or advertising.

data.name: Section3_Intro
data.value: We use the information we collect to:

data.name: Section3_Item4
data.value: Send transactional emails (account confirmation, security notices, application status updates)

data.name: Section3_Item5
data.value: Understand aggregate Site usage through anonymized analytics

data.name: Section3_Outro
data.value: We do not use your information for advertising. We do not sell your data. We do not share your data with third parties except as described in Section 5.

data.name: Section4_Intro
data.value: Where applicable, we process your information on the following grounds:

data.name: Section4_Item1
data.value: Contract: Processing necessary to provide services you have requested (account management, CDRP application processing).

data.name: Section4_Item2
data.value: Legitimate interests: Security logging, fraud prevention, and anonymized analytics used to improve the Site.

data.name: Section4_Item3
data.value: Legal obligation: Retention of records required by law.

data.name: Section5_Intro
data.value: We use a limited set of third-party services to operate the Site:

data.name: Section5_Outro
data.value: All third-party providers are contractually bound to process data only as directed and to maintain appropriate security standards.

data.name: Section6_Item1
data.value: Account data: For the life of the account, plus 90 days after deletion request

data.name: Section6_Item2
data.value: CDRP application data: For the duration of any applicable panel term, plus 3 years

data.name: Section6_Item3
data.value: Contact form submissions: 2 years from date of submission

data.name: Section6_Item4
data.value: Security and login logs: 1 year on a rolling basis

data.name: Section7_Text
data.value: We use industry-standard measures to protect your data, including encrypted storage of application data, HTTPS for all connections, hashed passwords, and multi-factor authentication support. No security measure is absolute. If you have reason to believe your account has been compromised, contact us immediately.

data.name: Section8_Item1
data.value: Access the personal data we hold about you

data.name: Section8_Item3
data.value: Request deletion of your account and associated data

data.name: Section8_Item5
data.value: Withdraw consent where processing is consent-based

data.name: Section8_Text1
data.value: To exercise any of these rights, use the account management tools in your dashboard or contact us at privacy@kindredlabsfoundation.org. We will respond within 30 days.

data.name: Section8_Text2
data.value: If you are located in the European Economic Area or the United Kingdom, you may also have the right to lodge a complaint with your local data protection authority.

data.name: Section9_Text
data.value: The Site is not directed at children under the age of 13. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children under 13. If we learn we have done so, we will delete it promptly.

data.name: Section10_Text
data.value: We may update this policy as the Site and its services evolve. Material changes will be communicated by updating the "Last updated" date and, where appropriate, by email notification to registered users. Continued use of the Site after any change constitutes acceptance of the updated policy.
